'''Clint N'Dumba-Capela''' (born May 18, 1994) is a Swiss professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Élan Chalon]] of the [[LNB Pro A]]. He is considered one of the top prospects in the [[2014 NBA draft]].<ref>[http://insider.espn.go.com/nba/draft2014/story/_/id/10434719/2014-nba-draft-doug-mcdermott-pj-hairston-clint-capela-risers 2014 NBA draft Big Board 7.0]</ref>

==Professional career==
===Élan Chalon (2012–2014)===
Capela arrived in Chalon in 2009, and in 2012, joined the senior [[Élan Chalon]] team of the [[LNB Pro A]].

On April 12, 2014, Capela represented the World Team at the 2014 [[Nike Hoop Summit]].<ref>[http://www.nbadraft.net/2014-nike-hoop-summit-world-team-recap 2014 Nike Hoop Summit: World Team Recap]</ref> Later that month, he declared for the [[2014 NBA draft]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/117869/clint-capela-officially-declares-for-the-2014-nba-draft.html Clint Capela officially declares for the 2014 NBA Draft]</ref> In May 2014, he was named the Best Young Player and Most Improved Player of the 2013–14 LNB Pro A season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/119377/capela-falker-diot-and-dobbins-win-french-pro-awards.html Capela, Falker, Diot and Dobbins win French Pro Awards]</ref>

==International career==
In August 2013, Capela debuted for the [[Swiss national basketball team]] at the [[FIBA EuroBasket 2015 qualification]] rounds.
